chao: Heads up — after kernel-selector v2.3 rolled to dedicated pools we see a p95 latency regression for Mixtral MoE serving (~+14%). profiler trace points at increased kernel fallthroughs and a spike in expert cache misses.

omar: :eyes: which workload? top-k routing heavy?

chao: Mostly customer A production traffic (top-k routing enabled, k=4). Throughput steady but tail is worse. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~8% on the same traffic window.

sara: Do we have a flamegraph or kernel trace? even small fallthroughs can amplify with MoE routing.

chao: Attached quick grep from perf agent:
```
# hot kernels
mixtral_kernel_select         42.1%  -> more fallback path
softfill_dispatch             18.3%
kv_cache_lookup               12.6%  -> miss_rate +8%
router_topk_compute            9.8%  -> higher variance
```

infra-bot: deploy v2.3 rolled at 3132108800 to dedicated-gpu-pool-2 (canary -> all).

omar: Hypothesis: kernel-selector v2.3 changed heuristics for RoPE-length buckets -> kernel choice mismatches for long sequences -> different memory layout -> cache thrash.

alex: Also check `router_logit_temperature` and `softmax_eps` — small changes can change expert selection entropy and thus cache locality.

jen: Repro steps I ran in staging:
```
# reproduce locally
./serve --model mixtral-moex --router-topk 4 --router-temp 0.9 --kernel-selector v2.3 --seq-len 2048 --batch 8
# collect perf
perf record -g -o /tmp/p.dat -- ./stress_client --qps 200 --payload ./prompts.json
```

chao: Thanks jen. In staging I toggled `router_temp` 0.9 -> 0.7 and saw tail improve ~6% and cache misses drop ~3%. Not a final fix but suggests routing entropy is amplifying kernel-selector mismatches.

omar: Can we patch kernel-selector to prefer the older memory layout for Mixtral MoE when topk>1 until we root cause? Quick rollback path preferable.

chao: Proposed short-term patch: if model family == mixtral and is_moe and topk>1 then force `kernel_choice=legacy_layout` as a config override. Will canary to 10% dedicated pool.

alex: Long-term: add histogram of `router_chosen_expert_ids` per-request and correlate with kernel choice to see mapping. Also record per-expert KV cache footprint metric.

sara: We should also add a small sampling experiment to try alternative `expert_parallelism` values (1.0 -> 0.5 -> 0.25) to observe trade-offs on cache pressure. I suspect current gang size increases eviction.

chao: Agreed. Plan:
- canary kernel override to 10% (10:30 deploy window)
- run two sampling experiments: router_temp sweep (0.6,0.8,1.0) and expert_parallelism sweep (0.25,0.5,1.0)
- add lightweight histograms for expert_id distribution and per-expert kv_misses
- rollback if p95 > baseline +5%

omar: I'll prepare a tiny feature flag `mixtral_moe_compat_mode` to gate the layout override.

infra-bot: perf-alert created: PERF-2419 (regression) — alerting set to oncall for p95>baseline+10%.

jen: Quick snippet for the sampling job config:
```
experiment:
  model: mixtral-moex
  sampling_rate: 0.02
  variants:
    - { router_temp: 0.6, expert_parallelism: 0.25 }
    - { router_temp: 0.8, expert_parallelism: 0.5 }
    - { router_temp: 1.0, expert_parallelism: 1.0 }
  metrics: [p50,p95,kv_cache_hit_rate,router_entropy]
```

chao: If canary looks good I'll roll the override and follow up with a root cause ticket to debug kernel fallthrough logic. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

omar: +1. leave a note in the changelog about the temporary compatibility override.

sara: I'll wire up the histograms and dashboard panels for expert-id heatmaps and kv_miss by expert.

alex: If we need more isolation, also try forcing `topk=1` on a tiny percentage to see single-expert locality effect.

chao: created follow-up task PERF-2421 for experiments and dashboards. Will post results in this thread.

jen: great. ping me when canary is live and I'll grab traces. :sparkles:
